supplement.statement: For this assumption-augmented experiment only, interpret the printed volumetric-flow magnitude Q = 2.2 × 10^5 m^3 as Q = 2.2 × 10^5 m^3 day^-1. The time denominator is an explicit user-authorized supplementary input, NOT a datum printed in the original problem and NOT an official erratum. All other inputs, prior-part derivation/fallback rules, requested outputs and numeric-reporting requirements are unchanged. Derive the requested energy under this assumption, and label the Lean model and task report with assumption id t4_a8_flow_per_day_user_approved. A passing result is conditional on this supplement, never an unconditional original-paper result.
